IDQ20790
Australian Government Bureau of Meteorology

Final Flood Warning for the Mary River

Issued at 8:08 am AEST on Wednesday 4 November 2026
Flood Warning Number: 2


FLOODING NO LONGER EXPECTED AT MIVA AND TIARO

Flooding is no longer expected along the Mary River at Miva and Tiaro. Thunderstorms
remain possible during Wednesday but forecast rainfall totals are not expected to
significantly affect river levels.

Mary River downstream of Gympie:
Flooding is no longer expected along the Mary River downstream of Gympie.

The Mary River at Miva is currently at 3.11 m and steady, below the minor flood level. The
Mary River at Miva is expected to remain below the minor flood level (7.50 m).

The Mary River at Tiaro is currently at 3.14 m and steady, below the minor flood level.
The Mary River at Tiaro is expected to remain below the minor flood level (6.00 m).

Safety Advice:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous.
* Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways.
* Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads.
* Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay
informed.
* For local emergency management warnings and advice visit
www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.

For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening
emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.

Next issue:
This is a final warning. No further warnings will be issued for this event.
